1996088597593300994.artist_bio:
刘嘉颖(CryptoZR)

曾就职于腾讯总部，担任国际业务部Global SNS首席产品设计师。2016年考入中央美术学院攻读硕士学位，读研期间专注于使用区块链底层技术进行艺术转化，并不断探索独特的艺术语言。2017年开始创办区块链企业，作为创始人身份参与了ProChain、YFII与TopBidder三个项目，2019年因业务繁忙休学一年，2020年获中央美术学院硕士学位。

作品收藏:
《红与蓝》被韩国蔚山美术馆收藏

Mrs Jiaying Liu (CryptoZR) has experience working at Tencent headquarters as the Chief Designer of Global SNS at International Business Department.
In 2016, she enrolled in China Central Academy of Fine art(CAFA) to pursue her master degree. During her studies, she focused on using underlying blockchain technology to explore artistic transformation and kept developing unique artistic languages.

Since 2017, she founded blockchain enterprises ProChain, TopBidder and YFII.
In 2019, she took a gap year away from school due to the business and in 2020 received a master of fine arts degree from China Central Academy of Fine Arts.

In the year 2021, CryptoZR held a solo CryptoArt exhibition at Guardian Art Center in Beijing titled: COOKIE COOKIE, the first ever exhibition of it’s kind.

1853719090968006656.description: 《模仿游戏》是一件借助PoseNet人体姿态识别算法从而学习人类肢体语言的机器人装置艺术作品。作品主体是一个婴儿形态机器人，它可以识别并记录观众的肢体动作，通过算法驱动电机进行学习和模仿。随着数据集的拓展和算法的迭代，它将跟随观众学会更多的人类肢体语言。这件作品试图以这样一种戏谑的方式和荒诞的游戏感，启发人们重新思考机器智能背后的技术伦理问题。

comments.name: 顾振清
comments.comment:
李杭《模仿游戏》是一场关于智能与人性的奇妙对话，借助PoseNet人体姿态识别算法，赋予婴儿形态的机器人观察与模仿的能力。观众的每一次动作都被实时捕捉并转化为学习素材，推动机器人不断扩展自身的“身体语言词典”。这一动态过程不仅是技术与艺术的结合，更是对人类自我认知的反思。作品具有天真的外表与潜藏的技术深度，通过诙谐的形式感与逐步进化的互动性，打破了机器冷漠的刻板印象。同时，作品又以“模仿”游戏的潜移默化特性提出警示：人类行为在被复制的同时，技术与伦理的界限正在被悄然重构。《模仿游戏》像一面镜子，映射出人类面对人工智能时的矛盾心理，触发对技术依赖与创造力边界的深层次思考：当机器渐次模仿乃至接近人类行为时，技术伦理的边界何在？《模仿游戏》通过这一微妙而颠覆性的创作，邀请观众直面人工智能时代的伦理挑战与文化命题。

Li Hang’s “Imitation Game” is a fascinating dialogue between intelligence and humanity. Using the PoseNet human pose recognition algorithm, the work grants a baby-shaped robot the ability to observe and imitate. Every movement by the audience is captured in real-time, transforming into learning material that expands the robot’s “body language dictionary.”

This dynamic process is not only a fusion of technology and art but also a reflection on human self-awareness. With its innocent appearance and underlying technical depth, the work disrupts the stereotype of machine coldness through its whimsical form and progressively evolving interactivity. Simultaneously, it raises a subtle warning: as human behavior is replicated, the boundaries between technology and ethics are quietly being redrawn.

“Imitation Game” acts as a mirror, reflecting humanity’s ambivalent attitudes toward artificial intelligence. It provokes deeper consideration of the boundaries between technological dependence and creative freedom: as machines increasingly imitate and even approach human behavior, where do the ethical boundaries of technology lie? Through this nuanced and subversive creation, the work invites viewers to confront the ethical challenges and cultural questions of the AI era.

1853010838592557056.description:
简而言之，梦想被过滤和设计成珠宝和3D打印制作动画和游戏。

自2020年以来，我发现自己出现了一些呼吸问题，无法深度睡眠。尤其是在冬天，他会做很多奇怪的梦，这些梦在他的梦里都是特别真实的。后来，他在成都呆了太久，发现自己得了慢性咽炎。医生说这在城市里是一种普遍现象，他们甚至不需要开处方药。

2015年，陈某开始写下梦中的场景，并在筛选后开始设计珠宝，并计划将这些珠宝送给他的枕边人——陈太太，因为他在梦中游泳时，陈太太忍着他的鼾声。

为了更好地还原梦境的设计，他打算通过3D打印和3D动画来呈现这些梦境，于是他开始自学3D建模和3D动画。

就这样，作品的结尾是珠宝首饰，戴在妻子身上，将超现实的梦境带回现实生活。

In short, dreams are filtered and designed into jewelry, 3D-printed, and made into animations and games.

Since 2020, I’ve experienced some breathing issues, making it difficult to sleep deeply. Especially in winter, he often has strange dreams that feel particularly real within the dream. Later, after spending too long in Chengdu, he found he had developed chronic pharyngitis. The doctor mentioned this is a common condition in the city and didn’t even require prescription medication.

In 2015, Chen began recording scenes from his dreams and, after filtering them, started designing jewelry. He planned to gift these pieces to his bedside companion—Mrs. Chen—who tolerated his snoring while he swam through his dreams.

To better bring these dream designs to life, he intended to use 3D printing and 3D animation, so he began teaching himself 3D modeling and animation.

Thus, the work culminates in jewelry, worn by his wife, bringing surreal dreams back into real life.

comments.name: 顾振清
comments.comment:
陈镪作品《多梦症》是一首浪漫情歌式的视觉诗篇。艺术家把虚拟的梦境碎片当作语言的钻石，试图直接物化为3D打印的物理现实。这是一场关于记忆与情感的跨维度旅程。艺术家以珠宝设计为媒介，将他无法释怀的冬夜梦境转化为视觉与触觉的载体。他凭借3D建模与动画技术，将超现实的梦幻场景作数字化重现，再通过3D打印与后期加工制作成闪闪发光的珠宝首饰。这美丽如梦的3D 实物不仅是一件佩饰，更是虚拟与现实交融的象征。它们诉说的是人类最深层的情感与记忆。作品以其诗意的叙事手法和精巧的建模技术，润物无声地重新定义了数字化的生活方式，以及跨越虚实边界的灵感。

Chen Qiang’s work “Polydreaming” is a romantic ballad-like visual poem. The artist treats fragments of virtual dreams as diamonds of language, attempting to materialize them directly into the physical reality of 3D printing. This is a multidimensional journey through memory and emotion. Using jewelry design as a medium, the artist transforms his lingering winter night dreams into tangible visual and tactile forms. Through 3D modeling and animation techniques, he digitally recreates surreal dreamlike scenes, which are then crafted into sparkling jewelry through 3D printing and post-processing. These dreamlike 3D artifacts are not merely ornaments but also symbols of the fusion between the virtual and the real. They tell stories of humanity’s deepest emotions and memories. With its poetic narrative approach and exquisite modeling techniques, the work subtly redefines the digital lifestyle and inspires creativity that transcends the boundaries between illusion and reality.

1849241310708502528.description:
波形是一套基于空间场域实时数据的沉浸式数字交互系统，通过不同维度数据感知、反馈技术模块的叠加融合产生持续迭代进化系统形态。该系统以后计算机时代社会智能化需求的扩张为背景，创造了一个虚构情境的互动空间，旨在探讨关于后人类状况下生命的议题。当观众进入系统场域时，其身份由外部观察者转变成为系统中的数据流动变量，观众的每一个行为、动作和存在都被即时采集、处理和转译成数据，与系统融合，并通过系统算法图像模块对观众作出即时响应。在这个场域中，不存在绝对的主体性，观众和系统相互交织，共同构建了一个活态的生态系统。
此系统版本基于“拟态环境（pseudo-environment）”概念内核，接入生物模拟算法构成数字拟态场域，并通过离线算力环境搭建、区块链加密、元宇宙在线运行环境部署等模块组合形成系统分支。
The HELLOWAVE system is an immersive digital interactive system based on real-time spatial field data, where different dimensions of data perception and feedback are overlaid and integrated to create a continuously evolving system. This system is developed against the backdrop of the expanding social intelligence needs in the post-computer era, creating an interactive space within a fictional context, aimed at exploring the issues of life in a post-human condition. When the audience enters the system's field, their role shifts from that of an external observer to a flowing data variable within the system. Every behavior, action, and existence of the audience is immediately collected, processed, and translated into data, which then merges with the system. The system's algorithmic image module responds to the audience in real-time. In this field, there is no absolute subjectivity; the audience and the system are intertwined, jointly constructing a living ecosystem.
This version of the system is based on the concept of a "pseudo-environment" and incorporates bio-simulation algorithms to form a digital mimetic field. Additionally, it integrates modules such as offline computational environment setup, blockchain encryption, and metaverse online operational environment deployment, forming various branches of the system.
1849241310708502528.tag: 空间交互,数字生物,系统

comments.name: 顾振清
comments.comment:
张海超作品《波形》是一部开创性的数字交互艺术作品，它以实时数据的感知与反馈为媒介，构建了一个永不停歇的迭代进化系统。在这个虚构的场域中，观众不再是被动的旁观者，而是数据流动的变量，其每一个行为与存在都与系统深度交织，共同塑造了一个动态的数字生态。作品以“拟态环境”为系统的概念内核，融合生物模拟算法、区块链加密技术和元宇宙部署，将虚拟与现实边界进一步模糊。它是关于后人类状况的深刻探讨，也是对人类主体性与人类中心主义不断消解的哲学思考。通过如此丰富且严密的技术体系，《波形》不仅为观众呈现了一种沉浸式体验，更揭示了技术与生命交互中潜藏的无限可能，从而建构数字艺术的一种全新意义。

Zhang Haichao’s “HelloWave Pseudo-field” is a groundbreaking piece of digital interactive art that uses real-time data perception and feedback as its medium, creating an endlessly iterative and evolving system. In this fictional realm, viewers are no longer passive observers but active variables within the data flow. Their every action and presence deeply intertwine with the system, collectively shaping a dynamic digital ecosystem.

The work is centered around the concept of a “mimetic environment,” integrating bio-simulation algorithms, blockchain encryption, and metaverse deployment to further blur the boundaries between virtual and real. It serves as a profound exploration of the post-human condition and a philosophical critique of the dissolution of human subjectivity and anthropocentrism.

Through its richly layered and rigorously constructed technological framework, “HelloWave Pseudo-field” not only offers an immersive experience but also reveals the hidden potential of the interplay between technology and life. It redefines the meaning of digital art by constructing a new paradigm where art, technology, and existential inquiry converge.

1848434786163625984.description:
Alex Long Yuan’s “Sustainability Resonator” is a global co-creation art project that gathers sustainable voices from around the world and, with the help of modern technology, continuously integrates, transforms, and releases these voices. The artist aims for the project to transcend boundaries between species, regions, cultures, races, and genders, spreading the concept of sustainability to every corner of the world. The artist attempts to create an energy body to express the necessity and effectiveness of aggregation in the face of today’s complex and severe environmental issues. Among the various forms of energy, Yuan Long chose the wave. A wave is a carrier of energy transmission and represents both tides and trends. Sound waves, being one of the fundamental carriers of thought, are where most communication, knowledge, emotions, and ideas originate. Therefore, guided by the idea of “sustainability,” the artist aggregates invisible sound waves, much like gathering emotions, ideas, and attitudes, and visualizes them into a “resonance body” installation through parametric design. When viewers enter the cavity of this “resonance body” installation, they activate the sound of each “sound unit,” and as the sounds reverberate, thoughts and ideas resonate within the space as well.
The creation of the installation involves thousands of participants, each contributing their unique “voice,” with each “sound unit” being one of a kind. When visitors enter the installation and listen to the sounds via their mobile devices, they complete the activation of the “resonance.” The concept of sustainable development is reflected not only in the sustainability of the materials but also in the design of the installation’s structure, which is created to be infinitely expandable. This represents that as more people join in, the resonance body will continue to grow, unleashing infinite energy.
This video is the conceptual film for the project, and the sounds in the video come from people of different countries, regions, races, genders, and industries across the globe, each expressing their thoughts and visions for a sustainable future from their own perspectives.
袁隆的“可持续共鸣体”是一个面向全球征集可持续之声，并借助现代科技，将声音不断聚合、创变和释能的全球共创艺术项目。艺术家希望借此项目让可持续的理念跨越不同物种、地域、文化、肤色、性别等之间的边界，并传遍世界每一个角落。艺术家尝试构建一个能量体，用以表达在现今复杂而恶劣的环境问题中，聚合的必要性和有效性。在众多能量形态中，袁隆选择了波（wave）。波是能量的传导载体，波又代表着浪潮和趋势。而声波则是思想的基本载体之一，大部分的交流、知识、情感、观念都是从声音传递开始的。因此，以“可持续”为引，艺术家将无形之声波聚合，如同将大量情感、观念与态度聚集，通过参数化设计，视觉化的呈现出一个“共鸣体”装置。当观众进入“共鸣体”装置作品的腔体中，激发每一件“声音单元”的声音，声音回荡，思想和观念亦在腔体内共鸣。整件装置的创作由数千名发声者以自己独特的“声音”参与其中，每一片“声音单元”均独一无二，而参观者进入装置，通过手机聆听声音时，就完成了“共鸣”的激发。持续发展的理念不仅体现在材料的可持续性上，整个装置的结构被设计成可无限延展的特质，代表当更多的发声者参与，这个共鸣体将被无限扩大，激发无限能量。
本视频为项目概念视频，其中的声音来自世界各地不同国家、地区、种族、性别和行业的人们，他们从各自的角度表达了对可持续未来的思考与愿景。

comments.name: 顾振清
comments.comment:
袁隆《可持续共鸣体》是艺术家以全球视野和前瞻性思维构建的跨文化艺术项目，它以声音为媒介，突破人种、地域、宗教与文化的界限，将“可持续”的理念凝聚成一场全球共创的艺术行动。通过声波波形这一能量传导与思想表达的符号，艺术家创造出一个不断聚合、创变、释能的共鸣体，展现了在复杂环境问题下聚合与协作的可能性与必要性。作品以数千发声者的独特声音为基础，通过参数化设计，将这些声音转化为可视化的“声音单元”，构建出一个既具象又抽象的装置艺术。观众的“雁过留声”的人机交互方式，其实是置身于共鸣体可持续的系统之中，激活装置的回响，从而完成一场思想与情感的集体交融。装置结构具有无限延展性，象征着全球参与与能量积聚的无尽可能。袁隆用这一恢宏的艺术构想提醒人们，在多元与共鸣中，人类可以找到通往可持续未来的共同路径。

Alex Long Yuan’s “Sustainability Resonator” is a cross-cultural art project crafted with a global perspective and forward-thinking vision. Using sound as its medium, the project transcends boundaries of race, geography, religion, and culture, distilling the concept of “sustainability” into a collective global art initiative. Through the symbol of soundwave patterns—representing both energy transmission and intellectual expression—the artist creates a continuously aggregating, transforming, and energizing resonance body. This body underscores the possibilities and necessities of collaboration in addressing complex environmental challenges.

The work is grounded in the unique voices of thousands of participants. Using parametric design, these voices are transformed into visualized “sound units,” forming an installation that is both figurative and abstract. Audience interaction with the installation—leaving their “voices” behind in a human-machine dialogue—immerses them within the sustainable system of the resonance body. This interaction activates the installation’s echoes, completing a collective exchange of thoughts and emotions.

The structure of the installation is infinitely extendable, symbolizing the boundless potential for global participation and energy convergence. Yuan Long’s grand artistic vision serves as a reminder that in diversity and resonance, humanity can discover a shared path toward a sustainable future.

1846214466740555776.description:
Will artificial life develop according to our assumptions? Since Thomas Ray, a scientist, tried to build the artificial life platform Tierra on the virtual machine in the last century, our simulation of artistic life has never stopped. My work Digital Honeycomb is an interactive image work based on EEG equipment. The work uses Kevin Kelly's concept of honeycomb society to summarize the decentralized characteristics and self-organization system of artificial life system as a kind of hive mind. And then I put forward my own thinking whether the highly autonomous hive mind will lead to the simplification and extremism of social group consciousness? Adopting wave function collapse algorithm, the work sets several triangle voxel modules as the initial cells of life, and voxels will find their corresponding interfaces to grow among them. At the same time, the audience links their brain waves to the artificial life system through the device(EEG equipment) to show the process of consciousness confrontation between the audience and an artificial life organization.
In the work, after each interactive confrontation, artificial life will be prompted to seek a new iterative direction, showing the game between the individual thinking represented by human beings and the collective thinking represented by computer simulation under open evolution. With these in mind, the work promotes people to think: (1) How can we find a balance between control and out of control in the process of our constant attempts to "synthesize life" in the future? (2) How can the complexity of human society and the highly unified ideal of autonomy in the future society realize the coexistence?

comments.name: 顾振清
comments.comment:
刘佳钰《数字蜂巢》是一件以人工生命为主题的互动作品，探讨了个体思维与集体意识之间的张力。通过脑电图设备，观众与一个自组织的生命系统相连接，共同经历意识的对抗与博弈。艺术家通过波函数坍缩算法模拟生命的迭代进化，呈现了科技与人类意识在开放进化下的碰撞与融合。作品不仅思考人工生命的演化，也对未来社会的复杂性进行深刻反思：在人工生命快速发展的控制与失控之间，人们该如何寻找平衡？人类的差异性个体与人工生命集体思维该如何实现并存于共生？这不仅是对人工生命的哲学探问，更是对人类与科技共同走向未来的深刻洞察。

Joey Liu’s “Digital Honeycomb” is an interactive artwork centered on artificial life, exploring the tension between individual thought and collective consciousness. Through EEG devices, the audience connects with a self-organizing life system, engaging in a shared experience of conscious conflict and negotiation.

The artist uses a wave function collapse algorithm to simulate the iterative evolution of life, depicting the collision and fusion of technology and human consciousness in an open evolutionary process. The work not only examines the evolution of artificial life but also deeply reflects on the complexity of future societies: How can balance be found between control and chaos in the rapid development of artificial life? How can humanity’s individual diversity coexist symbiotically with the collective intelligence of artificial life?

This is not only a philosophical inquiry into artificial life but also a profound insight into the shared journey of humanity and technology toward the future.

1847197510297325568.description: One sentence introduction of the work: Water grows skin in a linguistic way, which is hidden and strong. All things are hidden under this tense surface, and you will meet countless selves in the magic mirror.

comments.name: 顾振清
comments.comment:
任若溪作品《水之皮肤》水以语言生长出皮肤，隐秘而强大，如同一面紧张的魔镜，将万物隐藏在其表面之下。作品中，水不仅是一种物质，更是思想与情感的载体。它流动、变幻，将观者引向无数个潜藏的个体自我。在这深邃的表象之中，艺术家探讨了个体与世界、现实与幻象之间的微妙关系。

Ren Ruoxi’s “Water Skin” presents water as a medium that grows a skin through language—mysterious and powerful, like a tense magic mirror concealing everything beneath its surface. In the work, water is not merely a substance but also a vessel for thoughts and emotions.

It flows and transforms, guiding viewers toward countless hidden facets of individual selves. Beneath its profound surface, the artist explores the delicate relationships between the individual and the world, between reality and illusion. The work invites contemplation of the unseen connections that define existence, weaving an intricate dialogue between the tangible and the intangible.

1847197510297325568.artist_bio: Ruoxi Ren is a new media artist with degrees from Tsinghua Fine Art Academy (BA, 2019) and the University of the Arts London (MA, 2021). Her diverse practice spans interactive installations, paintings, AI art, videos, and performances. Ren's work has been featured in prestigious venues like the Victoria and Albert Museum and Ars Electronica Festival. She skillfully blends digital and physical media to explore human-nature-machine relationships in the Anthropocene, emphasizing emotional depth and spiritual essence in her art.

1847153647604076544.description:
《山海经》可以看作是在长久的时间中不断发展的东方生态观，其中杂糅了经验、传说、想象和演绎。如果把这一发展过程看作是在经验、语言与想象的链条上，每一个听者和讲述者都成为这一叙事链条上的节点，共同构建出一个人与世界关系的生态图景。
“共同的想象”构想了一个由数据和算法构成的生命主体，这一主体也成为这一古老叙事的一环，共同参与续写《山海经》中生物形象的演变。作品以《山海经》文本为源点，通过人工智能工具，在文本与图像的相互生成中接力转换，构建了一个源于《山海经》却又完全不相同于原文本的世界。如果我们把这一古老文本理解为在过去漫长时间中，人类经验、语言与想象共同构成的叙事，那么在今天这个机器智能的环境下，技术是如何渗透于人类的思想和意识之中，在经验与数据、语言与编码、想象与算法的共同交织下，构建我们理解世界的新方式，并继续延展出一个新的故事。

comments.name: 顾振清
comments.comment:
邱宇《共同的想象》是一场关于古老叙事与现代技术的深度对话。作品以先秦古籍《山海经》神话为灵感源点，将人类漫长历史中积累的经验、语言与想象，与人工智能的算法与数据相融合，创造出一个既传承历史又自我革新的生命主体。在这一动态交织的世界中，《山海经》的叙事链条被重新续写，生成的图像与文本共同建构了一个既熟悉又陌生的生态图景。艺术家通过机器智能探讨了技术对人类思想意识的渗透、干预与驱动。当经验与数据、语言与编码、想象与算法彼此交织，人类对世界的理解方式被重新定义。作品不仅延展了《山海经》这一东方生态观的内涵，更揭示了技术时代如何重新书写人类与世界关系的新叙事，为传统与未来之间架起了一座奇幻而深邃的桥梁。

Qiu Yu’s “Common Imagination” is an in-depth dialogue between ancient narratives and modern technology. Inspired by the myths of the ancient Chinese text Classic of Mountains and Seas (Shan Hai Jing), the work merges humanity’s accumulated experiences, language, and imagination with AI algorithms and data to create a living entity that both preserves history and redefines itself.

In this dynamically intertwined world, the narrative threads of Shan Hai Jing are reimagined, with generated images and texts collectively constructing an ecological landscape that feels both familiar and alien. Through machine intelligence, the artist explores how technology infiltrates, influences, and drives human consciousness. As experience merges with data, language with code, and imagination with algorithms, humanity’s way of understanding the world is redefined.

The work not only expands the ecological philosophy embedded in Shan Hai Jing but also reveals how the age of technology rewrites humanity’s relationship with the world. It builds a fantastical and profound bridge between tradition and the future, offering a new narrative that intertwines the ancient and the modern, the human and the artificial.

1846933247179755520.description:
《向度•观》
2018年，8分13秒，3屏影像装置，画幅：16:9，音频2.0
任何事物的本质都会在时间的维度中去显现，时间是一种势，一种向度，是非具象的存在，我能“触摸”物体，却只能“感受”时间。任何事物都有属于自己的向度，但驱动这一切的内部因素又是什么呢？就像面前这个桌子，它被承载着的物品所膨胀，随着物品的逐渐增多，被阻隔在画面两方的你和我渐渐远离彼此。而当我们物质上和视觉上的“拥有”渐渐消失，你我之间的距离似乎又回到原点。桌子在这里既是一个有生命、有维度的个体，同时也承载着时间的流逝与欲望的膨胀，是一个被由各色物品所象征的诱惑与欲望来填充的容器，当美艳的色彩消散褪去，一切又都显得单调而乏味，唯一不变的则是你我之间循环的距离。

comments.name: 顾振清
comments.comment:
焦洋作品《向度•观》是一次关于时间与存在的深邃探索，它以三屏影像装置为媒介，揭示时间作为非具象存在的力量如何塑造人与物的关系。艺术家通过一张桌子的隐喻，将观众带入一个围绕距离、膨胀与回归的叙事场域。桌子既是个体的象征，又是时间流逝的载体，更是人性与欲望伸缩的容器。桌子上的物质不断堆积或消散，人与人之间的距离随之不断拉大或缩短，如此循环往复。作品以其鲜艳的色彩与静谧的流动，将时间的无形力量转化为可视化的艺术语言。当色彩褪去、欲望沉寂，单调的表象却激发了人们对本质的思考。《向度•观》不仅刻画了物与人、人与时间之间的张力，更以深刻的哲学意蕴质问：驱动这一切的内在动力究竟为何？

Jiao Yang’s work “Degree: View” is a profound exploration of time and existence, using a three-screen video installation to reveal how the intangible force of time shapes the relationship between people and objects. Through the metaphor of a table, the artist immerses the audience in a narrative space centered on distance, expansion, and return.

The table serves as a symbol of individuality, a vessel for the passage of time, and a container for the ebb and flow of human nature and desire. Objects on the table accumulate and dissipate, while the distance between individuals continuously expands and contracts in a cyclical rhythm. With vibrant colors and serene motion, the work transforms the invisible force of time into a visual artistic language.

As colors fade and desires quiet, the simplicity of the surface provokes deeper reflection on essence. “Degree: View” not only portrays the tension between objects and people, and between people and time, but also poses a profound philosophical question: what is the intrinsic force driving it all?

1846821947074285568.description: 短片《城市导论》以城市环境与人的关系为主题。对于主题的选择出发于多年城市求学生活中的种种真实感受，有序的，机械，冰冷，工业化的城市生活。人的个性被消磨，压抑。

comments.name: 顾振清
comments.comment:
王展《城市导论》以冷峻的镜头语言与深刻的叙事手法，探讨了城市环境与人类个体之间复杂而微妙的关系。作品源于多年城市求学生活的切身感受，从有序的机械运转到工业化的冰冷肌理，描绘出一个个压抑个性、消磨人性的都市景观。通过影像的节奏与情绪，艺术家揭示了在高度工业化的城市生活中，人类如何与环境产生对抗与妥协。王展的短片既是一次对现代城市生活的批判性审视，也是一次对人性与自由的深切叩问。它所唤起的沉浸式影像体验，激发观众去重新思考人与城市的共生关系。

Wang Zhan’s “Introduction to the City” uses stark visual language and profound storytelling to explore the complex and delicate relationship between urban environments and individual human existence. Drawing from the artist’s personal experiences of years spent studying and living in cities, the work captures urban landscapes that suppress individuality and erode humanity—ranging from the orderly mechanics of daily operations to the cold textures of industrialization.

Through the rhythm and mood of the imagery, the artist reveals the tension between confrontation and compromise as humans navigate highly industrialized urban life. Wang Zhan’s short film is both a critical examination of modern urban existence and a heartfelt inquiry into humanity and freedom. The immersive visual experience provokes viewers to reconsider the symbiotic relationship between people and cities, challenging them to reflect on what it means to coexist within these environments.

1846507829394018304.description: AI对图片的处理逻辑源自对像素矩阵的分析与重组，作品利用数字技术对经典名画的像素进行分类、排列和再造，展示了AI在图像处理上的能力，并揭示了其独特的生成方式。这种逆向生成解构了传统艺术的主观性，以数据和算法的逻辑性取而代之。作品从美术馆取材并再回美术馆展出，跨越了时间与空间，通过数字技术赋予经典名画新的意义，拓展了艺术的边界，也促使我们反思艺术家身份与艺术本质。在AI的介入下，艺术家与AI成为合作伙伴，改变了创作方式和观众对艺术的理解，并推动了对艺术社会角色的进一步讨论。
1846507829394018304.tag: 人工智能,数字技术,数字艺术,图像生成

comments.name: 顾振清
comments.comment:
这件以安格尔经典名画《瓦平松的浴女（Valpinçon Bather）》为素材的作品，借助AI技术，对传统艺术进行了像素层面的重组与再造，展现出一种全新的视觉逻辑与美学秩序。通过分析与排列，作品以数据和算法解构了艺术创作的主观性，将经典名画的内涵在数字技术的作用下延展至新的语境之中。作品在解构并重构美术史范本与美术馆空间的进程中，重新定义了艺术的边界。它不仅揭示了AI在图像处理上的独特生成能力，还促使人们反思艺术家的身份与艺术的本质。在这一创作中，AI成为艺术家平等的合作伙伴，重新塑造了艺术的创作过程和观看体验，同时为艺术在社会中的角色开辟了新的可能性，推动了中心化的传统文化基因与去中心化的未来智能领域的深度融合。

This work, inspired by Ingres’ classic painting “The Valpinçon Bather”, utilizes AI technology to reconstruct and reimagine traditional art at the pixel level, presenting a new visual logic and aesthetic order. Through analysis and rearrangement, the piece deconstructs the subjectivity of artistic creation using data and algorithms, extending the essence of the classic painting into a contemporary digital context.

By deconstructing and reconstructing a canonical example of art history within the framework of gallery space, the work redefines the boundaries of art. It not only showcases AI’s unique capabilities in image processing but also prompts a deeper reflection on the identity of the artist and the essence of art itself. In this creative process, AI becomes an equal collaborator, reshaping the methods of art creation and the experience of viewing.

The piece opens up new possibilities for the role of art in society, facilitating the fusion of centralized traditional cultural legacies with decentralized, intelligent futures. It challenges the conventional hierarchies of artistic practice while pioneering the integration of technology and creativity, offering a forward-looking vision of art’s evolving narrative.

1846507829394018304.artist_bio:
现任湖北美术学院影视动画学院教师，湖北省美术家协会会员，湖北省动漫协会会员，毕业于德国纽伦堡应用技术大学沟通设计专业，纽伦堡造型艺术学院，双硕士，中央美术学院访问学者。
主要从事数字影视艺术的实践教学与研究工作。迄今完成和指导影视作品几十部。

1846417201905668096.description: 《人间乐园》可以说是每一个艺术家都绕不开的作品：每一个时代都会向它致敬，AI的时代也是。我在GenAI社区作为一个贡献者，近来一直再分享我的模型，也有很多人在使用我训练的模型，因此我也想用我对AI技术的理解，借由这幅历史上的经典名画，阐述一下我对AI和人类关系的理解。人类的肉体和大脑能力有限，终究是需要靠AI来辅助甚至取代，以迈向下一个文明纪元。但AI爆发的现在，也不断让人担心一旦AI使人类从枯燥的重复劳动中解放，是否会像《人间乐园》里一样让人类更加放纵，从而一步步走向地狱。我把我以前的作品Blockie训练了模型，并以Blockie的视角重新再造了这个乐园。

comments.name: 顾振清
comments.comment:
艺术家以荷兰博斯名画《人间乐园》为桥梁，在历史经典文本与AI技术之间建立了一场跨越时空的对话。通过自训练的AI模型，艺术家将自己在元宇宙中重构山海经神兽形象的系列作品《块块神兽》与名画相融合，再造了一个全新的果冻世界般的赛博乐园。在这个虚拟构筑中，AI不仅是创造工具，更成为观察者与叙述者，以其冷静、精密的视角重新诠释人类的欲望与本能。作品深刻探讨了AI技术对人类未来的双重影响：它既展现了解放人的重复劳动的美好前景，同时又加重了追求感官享受、放纵从而堕落的阴影？在这个由数据与算法重塑的乐园中，艺术家以视觉语言呈现了人类迈向下一个文明纪元的焦虑与希望，并以元宇宙虚实共生的视角，呼应AI作为人类延伸的哲学命题。这不仅是一场向经典的致敬，更是一种对未来的凝视，作品提示每一个观者；如何反思技术与人性共舞的新语境？如何在进化与迷失之间寻找平衡。

The artist uses the Dutch master Hieronymus Bosch’s painting “The Garden of Earthly Delights“ as a bridge to establish a dialogue across time and space between historical classic texts and AI technology. By employing a self-trained AI model, the artist merges their series Block Beasts, which reconstructs mythological creatures from the Classic of Mountains and Seas in the metaverse, with Bosch’s masterpiece to create a cyber-paradise resembling a jelly-like world.

In this virtual construct, AI is not only a creative tool but also an observer and narrator, reinterpreting human desires and instincts through its calm and precise perspective. The work delves deeply into the dual impact of AI technology on humanity’s future: does it promise the liberation from repetitive labor, or does it intensify the shadow of indulgence and moral decay in the pursuit of sensory pleasure?

Within this paradise reshaped by data and algorithms, the artist uses visual language to express both the anxieties and hopes of humanity’s leap into the next epoch of civilization. Through the lens of the metaverse’s coexistence of virtual and real, the work reflects on AI as an extension of human philosophy. This is not only an homage to a classic but also a gaze into the future, prompting every viewer to ask: How do we reflect on the new context where technology and humanity dance together? How can we find balance between evolution and loss?

1845827709230518272.description:
项目“幻想的瘟疫”是艺术家在新型冠状病毒全球大流行时期对与生活的个体性思考。“幻想的瘟疫”这个概念最早是由弗朗切斯科·彼特拉克提出，后来被齐泽克用拉康的视角进行了解构。在导言中他提出了一个很有意思的观点：
在我们时代富有特色的各种对抗中，也许最关键的是日益破环着我们的生活的抽象化行为（以数码化，投机市场关系等等为伪装）和泛滥的伪具体形象之间的对抗。
而这种抽象化在当下生活中最大的体现就是日常语言的异化和膨胀，越来越多新的词汇被创造出来。这些新词汇往往并不是代指某种具象的事物，而是通过符号的罗列去创造出一个语义模糊的概念，然后这个概念化为符号再叠加产生一个新的语义模糊的概念。在这种不断抽象化的语境中，我们对于自身主体性的理解开始逐渐消解，伴随而来的是对于传统的经验，对于生活的认知，和对于道德观的判断的同时消解。一切都化成了一片动态的混沌。

艺术家通过刻意运用一些本该被应用在极端条件中的特殊摄影技法将其运用在日常拍摄条件下，图像中的具象形象被这种艺术家强加的技巧溶解，转换。而艺术家在创作时并没有赋予所运用的技巧有任何含义，对拍摄行为没有任何观点表达，对拍摄结果也没有任何预期。其创作行为本身仅仅是在遵循了创作之前所设定的一些拍摄规则，创作过程仅需要对规则本身负责，而在后期处理过程中努力去寻找一个视觉平衡点，让最终图像达到普世审美标准中。

comments.name: 顾振清
comments.comment:
朱自杰作品《幻想的瘟疫》是艺术家对新型冠状病毒大流行期间个体性与抽象化思维的深刻反思。作品关注的概念来源于哲学家齐泽克《幻想的瘟疫》一书。它揭示了当下人类生活中的异化现象。在数字化、市场投机与日常语言的膨胀中，概念的不断抽象化消解了个体的主体性，并使传统经验、道德判断和对生活的认知开始崩溃。艺术家将特殊摄影技法应用于日常拍摄之中，将图像中的具象形象加以溶解并转化。他避免为创作预设任何明确的含义或观点，仅在后期处理中寻找视觉平衡，最终呈现出一种模糊、动态的混沌。通过这一过程，艺术家以图像语言深度揭示了在现代生活的抽象化与符号化背后人类个体认知的消解与碎片化困境。作品似乎在诘问：在当今社会的语义迷雾中，人们是否已经失去了对生活的本质把握？

Zijie Zhu’s “The Plague of Fantasies” is a profound reflection on individuality and abstract thought during the COVID-19 pandemic. Inspired by Slavoj Žižek’s book “Pandemic! 2: Chronicles of a Time Lost”, the work examines the alienation pervasive in contemporary human life. In a world dominated by digitization, speculative markets, and the inflation of everyday language, the constant abstraction of concepts dissolves individual subjectivity and destabilizes traditional experiences, moral judgments, and life perceptions.

The artist employs a unique photographic technique to dissolve and transform concrete images into abstract forms. By avoiding any predetermined meanings or viewpoints, Zhu seeks only visual balance in post-processing, ultimately presenting a blurred, dynamic chaos. This process uses the language of imagery to deeply expose the fragmentation and dissolution of human cognition in the abstraction and symbolization of modern life.

The work raises a critical question: amidst the semantic fog of contemporary society, have we lost our grasp on the essence of life? Through its ambiguous yet evocative visuals, “The Plague of Fantasies” challenges viewers to confront the complexities of perception and meaning in a disoriented world.

comments.name: 顾振清
comments.comment:
张一帆作品《轮回（Circle）》中，艺术家通过对每个圆形元素的动态变化与周围环境的对话，揭示了生命的轮回与时间的循环。黑白灰的色调交替与流畅的运动轨迹相结合，形成了一个和谐的周期性表现，仿佛在诉说着自然界与生命本身的无穷韵律。这种细腻的节奏不仅仅是视觉的呈现，更是对存在的深刻反思。作品中的每一细节，都是时间和空间中彼此交织的见证，最终引导人们重新审视生命的流转与轮回，平衡人类与自然之间不断变化的关系。作品引导观者不得不凝视不断变异的形象，从而被带入一个无尽的周而复始的循环之中，感受着生生不息的生命力。

Zhang Yifan’s “Circle” explores the cycles of life and the passage of time through the dynamic interplay of circular elements and their surrounding environment. The alternating tones of black, white, and gray, combined with fluid motion trajectories, create a harmonious, cyclical expression that echoes the infinite rhythms of nature and life itself.

This subtle cadence is not merely a visual display but a profound reflection on existence. Each detail in the work bears witness to the interwoven nature of time and space, ultimately guiding viewers to reevaluate the flow and cycles of life and the evolving balance between humanity and nature.

The work compels viewers to focus on the constantly shifting forms, drawing them into an endless loop of repetition and renewal, where they can deeply sense the vitality and continuity of life. “Circle” becomes a meditative experience, inviting contemplation on the perpetual ebb and flow of existence.

comments.name: 顾振清
comments.comment:
孙宇《无尽之和》是一场始于微末、归向无限的视觉诗章。动画中的几何抽象图案在算法程序的驱动下，以独特透镜般的放大视角不断展开。动画完美匹配了从诞生至死亡的音频轨迹。其首尾相衔，仿若命运的圆环，轮回不止。在这循环之中，观者得以见证生命的韵律与时光的浩渺。这个视频不仅是一个抽象动画，更是对存在的深度探寻。艺术家以精确的构思与流动的画面，展现了生命的壮丽与渺小、个体的短暂与永恒。动画中每一个放大的细节，仿佛映射着生命进程中微不足道却意义深远的瞬间。而音频作为时间的象征，交织出情感的波澜与哲理的深邃，最终在轮回中归于平静，形成无尽的和谐之境。《无尽之和》不仅是对生死轮回的艺术表达，更是一种超越时间和空间的冥想。它在虚实之间捕捉生命的永恒节律，呼唤观众重新审视时间的无情与生命的奇迹。

Sun Yu’s “Andless” is a visual poem that begins with the minute and converges toward the infinite. Abstract geometric patterns in the animation unfold through algorithmic programming, presented with a unique lens-like magnifying perspective. The animation is perfectly synchronized with an audio track tracing the arc of existence, from birth to death, forming a continuous loop reminiscent of a ring of fate—an unending cycle.

Within this cycle, viewers witness the rhythm of life and the vastness of time. The video is more than abstract animation; it is a profound exploration of existence. With precise conceptual design and flowing visuals, the artist captures the grandeur and fragility of life, the fleetingness of the individual, and the eternity of the universal. Every magnified detail in the animation reflects seemingly insignificant yet deeply meaningful moments in life’s journey.

The audio, as a representation of time, intertwines waves of emotion with philosophical depth, ultimately settling into tranquility within the cycle, creating an eternal harmony. “Andless” is not only an artistic expression of the cycle of life and death but also a meditation that transcends time and space. It captures the eternal rhythm of existence in the interplay between reality and illusion, inviting viewers to reexamine the relentlessness of time and the miracle of life.

1840005303182168064.description:
This is a work that is generated cyclically between "quantum disorder" and "my appearance impulse".
Imagine a quantum moving in a certain area, and its trajectory will be messy and unpredictable on a macroscopic scale. First, I tried to imagine its messy and disorderly movement trajectory by drawing with my hands. Second, I supplemented it with its appearance and completed a picture (Quantum Bird-1a). After this, I made it into a copper engraving (Quantum Bird-1b) and broke it again, repetitively giving it a messy and unpredictable nature, pieced it together again for appearance purposes, and hung it up to form a green Space Device (Quantum Bird-1c).
Of course, it can continue to cycle, and all its processes are a very logical deduction to me.

comments.name: 段少锋
comments.comment:
金郑晓的《quantum bird-1》是其构建的一套视觉游戏，他应用绘画、版画通过多个步骤对一个事物进行不断地建构、解构最终形成一件新的装置。这是艺术家自己设定的一套行动规则，而意在探求秩序与偶然，逻辑与随机之间的行动空白。

金郑晓为自己设定了一套“游戏”规则，他从想象出发，经由绘画、版画最终形成一个空间装置，让我得以一窥其创作过程，同时作品呈现的结果也引导观众在艺术家设定的逻辑与想象中将游戏进行下去，从而产生一个新的结果的可能。也是试图在挑战数字技术带来的无序灵感的一种尝试。

Jin Zhengxiao's "quantum bird-1" is a visual game he has constructed, utilizing painting and printmaking through multiple steps to continuously build and deconstruct an object, ultimately resulting in a new installation. This piece represents a set of action rules defined by the artist, aiming to explore the voids between order and chance, as well as logic and randomness.

Jin Zhengxiao has established a "game" rule set for himself, starting with imagination and progressing through painting and printmaking to create a spatial installation. This process offers a glimpse into his creative journey, while the final result of the work guides viewers to continue the game within the artist's defined logic and imagination, leading to the potential for new outcomes. It also represents an attempt to challenge the disorderly inspirations brought by digital technology.

1844592264844808192.description:
Based on the mechanism of L-System, Encoded Life series attempt to build a complex iterative system that depicts the imaginary picture of life growing and expanding among the universe. L-system is a mathematical model used to describe natural growth behavior of certain types of organism like plants or human lungs. By adding rules and parameters to the algorithm, Encoded Life generates organic shapes and structures that keeps evolving. As Taoism says, ‘Dao begets One, One begets Two, Two begets Three, Three begets all things’. Building up from a simple set of rules, the image becomes so mysteriously beautiful with its arbitrarily complex composition. Encoded Life  encapsulates the life force that permeates all existence, showcasing the artist's exploration of the profound relationship between our internal experiences and the vast universe.

Each piece in the "Encoded Life" series is a testament to the artist's skill in harnessing mathematical models to create art that resonates with both the natural world and philosophical concepts. The first piece, with its intricate and delicate interplay of light and color, forms ethereal shapes that seem to float and expand in a dark void, capturing a sense of mysterious beauty. The second piece presents a dynamic and fiery composition, with swirling patterns that evoke energy and motion, highlighting the vibrant force of life. The third piece, featuring a softer and more pastel-like color palette, creates a serene and harmonious visual experience, embodying tranquility and balance. The fourth piece offers a cooler, almost cosmic representation, with blue and white hues forming intricate, flowing structures that evoke the vastness of space, suggesting the infinite expanse of the universe… Each artwork in the series builds from simple rules to reveal arbitrarily complex compositions, echoing the Daoist concept of creation and interconnectedness. Together, these pieces illustrate the artist's exploration of the profound relationship between our inner space and the physical outer space, portraying the life force that exists among all beings through a mesmerizing blend of natural growth patterns and philosophical depth.

"Encoded Life" explores the intricate relationship between the external objective world and the internal subjective experience, reflecting the intertwining and folding of these dimensions. This artwork constructs a narrative that examines humanity's quest to understand cosmic laws and integrate them with individual experiences. Displayed across multiple screens in an expansive open space, the piece invites viewers into an immersive environment where they can explore the macro and micro aspects of existence. The dynamic visuals generated through complex algorithms evoke a sense of awe, mirroring the vastness of the universe and the minutiae of molecular structures, prompting contemplation on the structure of existence and the essence of being.

The exhibition draws inspiration from a rich history of artistic responses to celestial phenomena, spanning over eighty years of creative exploration. It resonates with the polished aesthetics of space-age designs and the vibrant colors reminiscent of nebulae. The work's evolving visuals and soundscape aim to blend the audience's perception of reality with a meditative introspection, highlighting the fluid boundaries between the tangible and the intangible, the known and the unknown. "Encoded Life" encourages viewers to reflect on their place within the cosmos, fostering a deeper understanding of the interconnectedness of all things.

comments.name: 顾振清
comments.comment:
DaDa笪秋焱作品《生生不息》系列以L-System数学模型为根基，创造出一个从“一”开始、自内向外延展、层层递进、不断迭代至无穷的的复杂生命体系。艺术家以算法激活中国先哲老子的古老智慧，顺应并实践宇宙与生命运行的深层规律。L-System这一经典数学模型，广泛用于解析植物生长、人类气管结构及生态物体形态。DaDa笪秋焱以此模型为底层架构，给予光的形象以生命，注入生成规则，将枝干系统的层层递进化为内外空间交织的生命景观。作品以极简规则唤醒复杂之美，通过科学与艺术的融汇，展现出生命无穷生长的诗意与秩序。

DaDa Da Qiuyan’s “Growth and Continuity” series is rooted in the L-System mathematical model, creating a complex life system that begins with “one,” expanding outward, layer by layer, iteratively evolving toward infinity. The artist activates the ancient wisdom of Laozi through algorithms, aligning with and embodying the profound principles governing the universe and life.

The L-System, a classic mathematical model, is widely used to analyze plant growth, human bronchial structures, and ecological forms. DaDa employs this model as a foundational framework, imbuing the imagery of light with life and instilling generative rules. This transforms the progressive branching system into an intricate interplay of inner and outer spaces, forming a vibrant landscape of life.

Through minimalist rules that awaken the beauty of complexity, the work merges science and art to reveal the poetic harmony and order of life’s infinite growth.

comments.name: 顾振清
comments.comment:
郑宏昌作品《我的宇宙》通过昆明拍摄的影像素材为背景，运用多媒体实验动画与氛围音乐的延展性，探索时间与空间的深刻对话。艺术家在这片影像与声音交织的虚拟世界中，构建了一个富有层次与张力的视听空间，呈现出他内心的真实宇宙。作品的非线性叙事与抽象的视觉语言相结合，营造出一种超越常规时空框架的艺术体验。郑宏昌通过这种创新的表现形式，带领观众进入一个充满探索与反思的宇宙，其中每个细节都激发了人们对物理与虚拟、存在与虚无关系的深度思考。作品不仅是对艺术家自我宇宙的呈现，更是一次关于人类感知与意识拓展的实验。

Zheng Hongchang’s “My Universe” uses video footage captured in Kunming as a backdrop, blending multimedia experimental animation with expansive ambient music to explore a profound dialogue between time and space. In this virtual world where visuals and sound intertwine, the artist constructs a layered and dynamic audiovisual space that reveals his inner universe.

The work combines nonlinear storytelling with abstract visual language, creating an artistic experience that transcends conventional frameworks of time and space. Through this innovative form, Zheng invites viewers into a universe filled with exploration and introspection, where every detail provokes deep contemplation of the relationships between physical and virtual, existence and nothingness.

“My Universe” is not merely a presentation of the artist’s personal cosmos but also an experiment in expanding human perception and consciousness. It serves as both a reflection of the self and an invitation to consider the boundless possibilities of perception in a reality increasingly shaped by the convergence of the physical and virtual.

1844383116844732416.description:
A wood block whose volume is one cubic meter was overturned again and again to chase the light. Its shadow was filled up every time it was overturned until it cannot move. The shadow underneath wanted to chase the light but in vain. Finally.
一立方米木块的影子为了追逐光源而进行翻转，产生新的影子。每翻转一次就被填满，不断重复此过程。它可以变到无限的大，直到它在所在的空间无法翻转。

comments.name: 顾振清
comments.comment:
这件作品呈现了一种对光、影与空间之间关系的深刻反思。一立方米木块的影子在不断追逐光源的过程中，通过翻转与生成新的影像，探讨了无限扩展与空间限制的矛盾。根据预设规则，画面主体与影子的间隙总是在自动填满黑色阴影后立即翻转。而每一次新的翻转，它与新影子的间隙又被填满。这一过程的不断重复，最终达到无法再翻转的极限。这一极限象征着宇宙在无穷的扩展中最终不可避免的一种边界。木块及其影子在规定空间中循环不息地翻转，仿佛提示了一种对于“无限”与“终结”概念的哲学性思考。艺术家通过这一形式，借由简单的物理现象，揭示了人类对时间、空间与存在边界的无限追求中的自我局限。这个作品不只是对物质世界的呈现，更是对实在与虚无、反复与终结之间永恒博弈的思辨。

This work offers a profound reflection on the relationship between light, shadow, and space. A one-cubic-meter wooden block’s shadow, in its constant pursuit of the light source, flips and generates new images, exploring the paradox of infinite expansion and spatial limitation. According to pre-set rules, the gaps between the block and its shadow are filled with blackness, prompting an immediate flip. With each new flip, the gaps with the newly formed shadow are once again filled, repeating this process until an unflippable limit is reached.

This limit symbolizes the inevitable boundary of the universe’s infinite expansion. The wooden block and its shadow perpetually flip within a defined space, evoking philosophical contemplation of the concepts of “infinity” and “finality.” Through this cyclic motion, the piece subtly hints at humanity’s endless pursuit of the boundaries of time, space, and existence, juxtaposed with our inherent limitations.

The artist uses this form, grounded in simple physical phenomena, to reveal the eternal tension between materiality and void, repetition and resolution. This work transcends a mere depiction of the physical world, presenting a thoughtful meditation on the interplay between reality and nothingness, and the eternal struggle between repetition and conclusion.

1844383116844732416.artist_bio: Yueyanna：We feel the existence of the world around us because of the existence of our physical body. The body is a channel of contact with the world, a perception, a living being. Perception has always been the source of my creation. A beam of light, an object, an event, etc. may be the object I want to express. Through the works of art, my perception is transmitted to the audience, and at the same time, it affects the perception of the audience.我们之所以能感受到周围世界的存在，是因为我们肉身的存在。身体是与世界接触的通道，是知觉，是活动的存在。知觉一直是我创作的源泉，一束光、一个物、一件事等都有可能是我要表达的对象，通过艺术作品将自己的感知传递给观者，同时影响着观者的感知。

1838276249219371008.description:
《蛋形B红》通过动态雕塑把一个生命的荒诞形态、从产生到消亡的过程表现的如此直接而有力，金球传递虔诚而坚定，这不是一般对隐性世界简单的猎奇。也许内窥世界带来的是虚无，也许正是这虚无促发了他不甘心的勇力和真诚，把这虚无化为了一个生命的符号通过球体“金”的寓意再穿越继续着他对生命的追问之旅。作品中众生的所有个性特点几乎被全部隐去，而直现了作为生命的唯一符号-人型。损之又损，敢于把普通人津津乐道的个性张扬全部简掉，让生命共性符号能最直接呈现的力量，这需要的绝不仅仅是能力，而是悲情，一种对生命意义本身的大情怀；在自觉和非自觉之间，传递出艺术家对生命意义的天问。这不是普通艺术家的个人世界的小感悟，这正是触动观者的内在疑情。
《蛋形B红》动态雕塑，Φ40cm(w) x 63cm(h) 材料（不锈钢，亚克力，PLA， LED, 机械传动）2024
‘Egg Shape B Red’ Kinetic Sculpture，Φ40cm(w) x 63cm(h) material (stainless steel, acrylic, PLA, LED, motor drive) 2024

comments.name: 顾振清
comments.comment:
许仲敏借由作品《蛋形B：红》深刻追问生死无常的荒诞性与生命周而复始的永恒性。通过频闪灯下的动态雕塑，艺术家将生命从诞生到消亡的动态画面生动直观地展现给观者。笼罩生命演化景象的金球象征着虔诚与坚定，它不仅传递了一种内在的力量，也为存在的短暂与生命的轮回增添了一种深沉的东方哲思。艺术家深谙生命的无情限制，从而赋予了作品一种抵抗遗忘与死亡的精神力量。作品简化人类的个性特征，以人型符号强调生命的抽象本质。这种极简化的表现方式，刷新了人们对个体生命的常规理解。它通过个性化细节的空白与简化，激发了人们对生命共同体的深刻感悟。艺术家在作品中展现的对生命意义的深情追问，无疑牵动了观众心中对生命终极问题的永久关怀。

Xu Zhongmin’s “Egg-shaped B: Red” profoundly interrogates the absurdity of life’s impermanence and the eternal cycle of existence. Using a dynamic sculpture illuminated by strobe lights, the artist vividly portrays the journey of life from birth to decay. Encasing this evolutionary tableau is a golden sphere, symbolizing reverence and resilience. It conveys an inner strength while infusing the transience of existence and the cycle of life with a deep sense of Eastern philosophy.

Fully aware of life’s relentless constraints, the artist imbues the work with a spiritual force that resists oblivion and death. The sculpture simplifies human individuality into humanoid symbols, emphasizing the abstract essence of life. This minimalist approach reshapes conventional understandings of personal existence, leaving out individualized details to evoke a profound recognition of the shared experience of life.

Through this work, Xu Zhongmin poses an emotional inquiry into the meaning of life, stirring a deep and enduring contemplation of life’s ultimate questions within the viewer. It is a poignant exploration of life’s fragility and universality, invoking a shared reflection on existence itself.

1841188026215174144.description: In the era of human-machine interaction, humanity grapples with profound contradictions and existential concerns. The relentless march of technology, with its sights set on achieving Artificial Superintelligence (ASI), paints a complex picture of our future. Recently, some of Silicon Valley's most esteemed tech luminaries have made bold proclamations: ASI could emerge within the next decade. This projection raises pressing questions: once ASI surpasses human intelligence by a significant margin, what will the fabric of society look like? What path will humanity tread? The answers remain elusive, leaving us in a precarious state on the brink of a new dawn. At the heart of this technological trajectory is the rapid evolution of artificial intelligence. Machine learning algorithms, neural networks, and quantum computing are advancing at an unprecedented pace. AI systems are now capable of tasks that once seemed exclusive to human cognition, such as language translation, medical diagnosis, and even creative endeavors like composing music and generating art. The integration of AI into daily life has become so seamless that its presence is often taken for granted. However, as we edge closer to ASI, the implications grow exponentially more complex. ASI represents a paradigm shift unlike any before. While current AI operates within the constraints of human-designed parameters, ASI would possess the ability to improve and redesign itself autonomously. This self-improving capability could lead to an intelligence explosion, where ASI rapidly and exponentially enhances its cognitive abilities beyond human comprehension. Such an entity could solve problems that have stymied humanity for centuries, from curing diseases to addressing climate change. Yet, with this potential comes a host of ethical, philosophical, and practical dilemmas. One of the foremost concerns is control. As ASI becomes more intelligent, the ability of humans to manage or predict its actions diminishes. There is a palpable fear that an ASI could prioritize its objectives over human welfare, leading to scenarios where human interests are sidelined or, in the worst case, obliterated. This uncertainty fuels a broader anxiety about the future of work, privacy, and even the essence of what it means to be human. With ASI's capability to outperform humans in nearly every intellectual endeavor, the traditional structures of employment and economy could be upended, necessitating new models of societal organization and resource distribution. Furthermore, the ethical considerations surrounding ASI are profound. Questions about the rights and personhood of intelligent machines arise: if an ASI can think and feel, does it deserve rights akin to humans? How do we ensure that the development of ASI adheres to ethical guidelines that prioritize humanity's collective good? These questions are not merely theoretical; they demand immediate and thoughtful discourse among technologists, ethicists, policymakers, and the broader public. In addition to these ethical and practical concerns, there is a deeper, almost philosophical question about the place of humanity in the universe. For millennia, humans have been the apex of cognitive ability on Earth. The advent of ASI challenges this notion, prompting introspection about our identity and purpose. In a world where machines can outperform us, what role do humans play? How do we find meaning and fulfillment in such a landscape? In conclusion, as we stand on the precipice of a potential ASI breakthrough, humanity finds itself in a state of profound ambivalence. The promises of ASI are tantalizing, offering solutions to some of our most intractable problems. Yet, the risks and uncertainties are equally daunting. The path forward requires careful navigation, balancing optimism with caution, innovation with ethical responsibility. As we inch closer to this new dawn, the choices we make today will shape the trajectory of our future in ways we can sc…

comments.name: 顾振清
comments.comment:
在当今人机交互时代，这部作品以深邃的思想与生动的图像叙事探讨了超级人工智能（ASI）的可能性及其对未来的深远影响。在技术快速发展的浪潮中，机器学习、量子计算等领域的突破为未来绘制了一个既充满希望又令人忧虑的蓝图。作品不仅展示了人工智能如何颠覆传统认知与社会结构，更引发了对伦理、哲学及生存本质的深刻反思。当ASI的自我改进能力突破人类控制，人类势将面对无法预见的挑战。最严峻的考验是：人类该如何控制ASI这种日益自主的力量，避免它打破阿西莫夫的机器人三定律，将人类福祉置于次要地位，甚至威胁到人类生存。ASI让人类重新审视自身在宇宙中的地位。在一个机器可能超越人类的世界里，如何重新定义人类的身份与意义？机器超越生物智慧的边界，将改变现代人类社会传统的就业与经济结构，也迫使人们面对关于机器权利和道德的严峻问题。站在ASI即将到来的边缘，我们正面临着理性与创新、道德与责任之间的抉择。在此关头，我们的选择将塑造未来人类的命运。

In the era of human-machine interaction, this work employs profound thought and vivid visual storytelling to explore the potential of super artificial intelligence (ASI) and its far-reaching impact on the future. Amid rapid technological advancements, breakthroughs in fields such as machine learning and quantum computing sketch a blueprint for the future that is both hopeful and unsettling.

The work not only demonstrates how AI disrupts traditional perceptions and societal structures but also provokes deep reflection on ethics, philosophy, and the essence of existence. When ASI’s self-improvement surpasses human control, humanity will inevitably face unforeseen challenges. The most pressing question is: how can humanity regulate this increasingly autonomous force to prevent it from undermining Asimov’s Three Laws of Robotics, deprioritizing human welfare, or even threatening human survival?

ASI compels humanity to reassess its place in the universe. In a world where machines might surpass human capabilities, how can we redefine human identity and purpose? The boundary where machines exceed biological intelligence will reshape traditional employment and economic structures, forcing society to confront pressing questions about machine rights and morality.

Standing on the brink of ASI’s emergence, humanity faces a critical juncture of choices between rationality and innovation, morality and responsibility. The decisions we make now will shape the destiny of future generations, determining the trajectory of human coexistence with this transformative force.

1840362184878723072.description:
在现代性的迷宫中，技术渗透到人类生存的方方面面，《蝴蝶茶馆：机械变革》这个系列的主角，是脸与人工智能生成的结构融为一体，在这个复杂的叙事中既是主体又是客体。
通过技术媒介的身份置换反映了自我和机器之间日益模糊的关系，挑战了观众在一个越来越受人工智能支配的世界中质疑人类能动性的局限性。
《蝴蝶茶馆》探讨了技术体现的含义，质疑了人类和机器共存的形式意味着什么。蝴蝶以其精心制作的机械翅膀，象征着有机生命与合成增强的融合。该系列中的每一件作品都挑战观众在生物和人工之间的界限越来越模糊的时代思考身份的脆弱性。
角色不仅是技术实验的化身，也是一种新的存在状态的预兆一—一种通过数字和机械过程不断重建自我的状态。在这个世界里，身份、代理甚至现实本身的传统观念都被技术的无情进步所颠覆。
IN THE MAZE OF MODERNITY, TECHNOLOGY PERMEATES EVERY ASPECT OF HUMAN SURVIVAL. THE PROTAGONIST OF THE "BUTTERFLY TEAHOUSE:
MECHANICAL TRANSFORMATION" SERIES IS A FUSION OF FACE AND AI GENERATED STRUCTURE, SERVING AS BOTH SUBJECT AND OBJECT IN THIS COMPLEX NARRATIVE. THE IDENTITY EXCHANGE THROUGH TECHNOLOGICAL MEDIA REFLECTS THE INCREASINGLY BLURRED RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN SELF AND MACHINE, CHALLENGING THE LIMITATIONS OF AUDIENCES QUESTIONING HUMAN AGENCY IN A WORLD INCREASINGLY DOMINATED BY ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE.
THE BUTTERFLY TEAHOUSE EXPLORES THE MEANING OF TECHNOLOGICAL EMBODIMENT AND QUESTIONS WHAT THE COEXISTENCE OF HUMANS AND MACHINES MEANS. BUTTERFLIES, WITH THEIR CAREFULLY CRAFTED MECHANICAL WINGS, SYMBOLIZE THE FUSION OF ORGANIC LIFE AND SYNTHETIC ENHANCEMENT. EACH PIECE IN THIS SERIES CHALLENGES THE AUDIENCE TO CONTEMPLATE THE FRAGILITY OF IDENTITY IN AN ERA WHERE THE BOUNDARY BETWEEN BIOLOGY AND ARTIFICIALITY IS BECOMING INCREASINGLY BLURRED.
A CHARACTER IS NOT ONLY THE EMBODIMENT OF TECHNICAL EXPERIMENTATION, BUT ALSO A PRECURSOR TO A NEW STATE OF EXISTENCE - A STATE OF CONSTANTLY REBUILDING ONESELF THROUGH DIGITAL AND MECHANICAL PROCESSES. IN THIS WORLD, TRADITIONAL CONCEPTS OF IDENTITY, AGENCY, AND EVEN REALITY ITSELF HAVE BEEN OVERTURNED BY THE RELENTLESS ADVANCEMENT OF  TECHNOLOGY

comments.name: 顾振清
comments.comment:
李妍洁《蝴蝶茶馆：机械变革》中，艺术家以独特的方式呈现了技术与人类存在的交织与变革。面临日益模糊的界限，作品中的人的皮肤与人工智能生成的结构融合在一起。艺术家的探索不仅呈现了自我与机器之间复杂的关系，也引发了人类能动性在这个技术主导的时代所面临的深刻疑问。精制的机械蝴蝶翅膀象征着有机生命与合成增强的融合，也挑战着生物智能与AGI人工智能之间日益模糊的界限。在技术不断重塑现实的过程中，关于人与人性的传统观念正不断被超越。李妍洁作品让观者不得不反思人的自我身份的脆弱性，那么，人类将何以自处？未来的人类将如何重新定义？数字技术与人工智能加速演进突显了人类世界身份变革的必然性与未来身份的流动性。

Loxel Li’s “Butterfly Teahouse” presents a unique exploration of the intertwining and evolution of technology and human existence. In the face of increasingly blurred boundaries, the work portrays human skin merging with AI-generated structures. This exploration not only visualizes the complex relationship between self and machine but also raises profound questions about human agency in a technology-driven era.

Intricately crafted mechanical butterfly wings symbolize the fusion of organic life with synthetic enhancement, challenging the increasingly indistinct line between biological intelligence and AGI (artificial general intelligence). As technology continues to reshape reality, traditional notions of humanity and identity are being continuously transcended.

Loxel Li’s work compels viewers to confront the fragility of human self-identity: How will humanity define itself in such a world? How will the concept of “being human” be reimagined in the future? The accelerated evolution of digital technology and AI underscores the inevitability of identity transformation and the fluidity of future identities in the human world.

1840319536268709888.description: 作品创造了一个“后启示录”时代的森林景观。但这不仅仅是对自然环境的描绘，更是对人类活动、自然变迁以及未来可能性的探讨。这里的“森林群落”是一个经过时间冲刷、人类干预和自然恢复后形成的独特生态系统。这个生态系统可能充满了未知的生物种类、奇异的植物形态和独特的生态规律。

comments.name: 顾振清
comments.comment:
王雨萱作品《后启示录·森林群落》超越了传统的自然再现。它通过细腻的表现和深邃的叙事，创造了一个“后启示录”时代的森林群落的生态景观。人类与自然的关系、破坏与恢复的循环、以及时间的治愈力量，构成了一个反思与重构的空间。这是一首后自然时代的挽歌，也是对未来生态可能性的热切遐想。这里的“森林群落”经岁月侵蚀、人为雕琢与自然自愈，蜕变出独有的生态体系。其中，或隐匿着前所未闻的生物族群，或生长着形态诡谲的植物，遵循着复杂而别具一格的生态法则。作品不但让人见证了人类行为与自然环境的无休无止的纠葛，而且让人领略了外在世界不可预测的神秘未来。它既是警示，又是一种对未来生态的深邃洞察与理性思考。

Dolores Wang’s “Post-Apocalyptic Forest” transcends traditional depictions of nature, crafting an ecological landscape of forest communities in a “post-apocalyptic” era through intricate detail and profound storytelling. It explores the cyclical relationship between humanity and nature—destruction and restoration—while emphasizing the healing power of time, creating a space for reflection and reconstruction.

This work is both an elegy for the post-nature era and a fervent vision of future ecological possibilities. The “forest communities” portrayed are transformed through the erosion of time, human intervention, and nature’s self-healing, evolving into unique ecosystems. Hidden within may be previously unknown species or bizarrely shaped plants that follow intricate, singular ecological laws.

The piece not only showcases the relentless entanglement of human actions and natural environments but also unveils the unpredictable mysteries of an external world reimagined in the future. It serves as both a warning and a profound exploration of ecological possibilities, blending insightful reflections with rational thought about the interconnectedness of humanity and nature in shaping the world to come.

1840317672236126208.description:
作品以2088年的地球为背景，描绘了一个由超智慧植物构成的生态系统。这些植物拥有高度的智能和感知能力，能够与人类或其他生物进行交流和互动。
这些植物通过自我复制和进化，逐渐形成了独特的生态网络，获得超越人类的智慧和能力，进而成为地球上的主导生命形式。

1839922601653309440.description: 解剖剧场是一个从身体出发的虚拟展览，将解剖这一行为架构在过去与未来，解剖过去，解剖自我，解剖未来。整场展览探讨身体与意识、虚拟与现实、意识形态等问题，涵盖天人合一、身体观、数据主义、虚拟人类、网络隐私等观念，以环形空间为基地，构建了繁杂交织的剧场形态。

comments.name: 顾振清
comments.comment:
陈子健作品《解剖剧场》以解剖作为行为核心，将一个虚拟展览架构在身体意识的过去、现在与未来之间。艺术家在非线性叙事中，不断解剖过去的记忆、自我的存在以及未来的未知世界。虚拟展览涵盖了天人合一、身体观、数据主义、虚拟人类、网络隐私等理念，在环形空间内构建了一种错综复杂的剧场形式。这种形态不仅呈现了身体与科技、自然与人类之间的深刻关系，更激发观众对自我、社会及未来的深刻反思。通过虚拟化的空间和层层交织的视觉表现，作品让观者参与了一场探索人类存在边界的思想实验之旅。

Chen Zijian’s work “Anatomical Theater” centers on the act of dissection, constructing a virtual exhibition that bridges the past, present, and future of bodily awareness. In a nonlinear narrative, the artist continuously dissects past memories, the essence of self, and the unknown world of the future.

The virtual exhibition incorporates concepts such as the unity of heaven and humanity, perceptions of the body, dataism, virtual humans, and internet privacy, weaving them into a complex theatrical form within a circular space. This structure not only explores the profound relationships between body and technology, nature and humanity but also inspires deep reflections on self, society, and the future.

Through virtualized spaces and interwoven visual representations, the work invites viewers on an intellectual journey, an experimental exploration of the boundaries of human existence.

1839563492009578496.description:
This is a shackled and inflated digital creature in the modern society. It is an excellent expression of various states in which people constantly struggle to achieve balance against the pressure and liberation in an age when technologies supersede each other in rapid speed. The tactile quality, forms, and movements of bondbomb are generated by computer algorithms. On one hand, it challenges the standards of the physical world. On the other, it supplements the communication and interaction between man and machine with the help of computer logic.
In the NFT community, a large number of pictures and videos of bondbomb will be recreated, a form of participatory art.  At the same time, the real porcelain device and touch-screen interaction integrates with this NFT community culture in real time. Regardless of its creation being a faithful act of mimesis or through multi-dimensional clashes, like the source of sound waves, bondbomb finds its resonances and rebounds at all levels in virtuality or reality.
这是一个在现代社会中，被捆绑和充气产生的“数字生物”。极好的表达了在时代与技术迅速更迭中，人们不断增压、减压，反复挣扎平衡的各种状态。“数字生物bondbomb”的质感形态，动态,大量由计算机算法生成。一方面挑战着物理世界的各项标准，一方面借助计算机逻辑完成人机共谋的传播与交互。在NFT社群中，bondbomb 的画面和视频会被大量二次创作，参与。同时，现实世界的瓷装置，触屏交互与NFT社区文化实时交融。无论是照猫画“虎”还是各维度的碰撞交互。bondbomb 如同声波发射源，会在虚拟和现实世界中找到自己的各级共振与反弹。
1839563492009578496.tag: 数字生物,现实与虚拟交互

comments.name: 顾振清
comments.comment:
在薛雷动画作品《Bondbomb战争》中，艺术家以极具张力的视觉语言，创造出一个被捆绑与充气的“数字生物”，生动地表现了现代社会中人类在快速迭代的技术推动下反复增压、减压以追求平衡的生存博弈。通过计算机算法生成的动态形象，薛雷作品既挑战了物理世界的固有规则，又展现了人机共谋的虚拟事物在线上交互中不断生成、传播、繁殖的知识生产方式。在元宇宙线上社区，虚拟的“数字生物Bondbomb”的画面和视频被线上玩家广泛接受为二次创作的对象，由此形成了一种集体参与、多方共享的元宇宙独特叙事。而在现实世界，与Bondbomb形象相关的瓷器装置与触屏交互设备则进一步模糊了虚拟与现实的界限。作品如同声波的发射源，以其独特的质感和动态，引发虚拟与现实世界间的共振与反弹。这不仅是一场视觉与技术的实验，更是一种贯通线上、线下文化时空的全新互动方式。

In Lei XUE’s animated work “Bondbomb War”, the artist employs highly dynamic visual language to create a “digital organism” that is bound and inflated, vividly illustrating the survival struggles of humanity in a modern society driven by rapid technological iteration. Through cycles of compression and release, the piece explores the quest for equilibrium in an ever-evolving world.

The dynamic imagery, generated by computer algorithms, challenges the inherent rules of the physical world while showcasing the collaborative knowledge production processes of virtual entities created, disseminated, and reproduced through human-machine interactions. In the metaverse’s online communities, the virtual “Bondbomb” becomes a widely accepted subject for secondary creation by online players, fostering a unique narrative of collective participation and shared storytelling.

In the physical world, ceramic installations and touch-interactive devices related to the Bondbomb imagery further blur the boundaries between the virtual and the real. The work acts as a source of resonance, akin to a sonic wave generator, provoking reflections and reactions across both virtual and physical realms with its distinctive textures and motion.

Bondbomb War is not merely an experiment in visual and technological innovation but also a groundbreaking approach to bridging online and offline cultural dimensions. It introduces a novel mode of interaction, transcending traditional divides and inviting audiences to engage with the interplay of virtual and real-world experiences.

1839276472741793792.description:
《虚无》作品介绍：
     人生中充满了不确定性，这些不确定性在某种程度上可以被视为“虚无”。它们可能是未来的未知、内心的恐惧、生活的压力等。人们每天都在努力应对这些不确定性，试图在虚无中找到方向、意义和价值。
     从佛教哲学的角度来看，“人生本就是虚空”意味着人生的本质是无常和空性的。一切物质和精神的存在都是暂时的、变化的，没有永恒不变的实体。从这个角度来看，人生确实是虚空的，但这并不意味着人生没有意义或价值。相反，正是在这种虚空的基础上，人们才有机会去追求和创造真正的价值和意义。
1839276472741793792.tag: 虚无,成林,AI艺术,数字艺术

comments.name: 顾振清
comments.comment:
在成林作品《虚无》中，艺术家以深邃的哲学视角，捕捉了人生不确定性的本质。这种不确定性被诠释为一种广义的虚无。未来的未知、内心的恐惧、生活的压力，皆被包容在虚无之中。作品通过沉静而有力的AI影像表达，引导观众直面这些存在的虚空，探寻隐藏在其中的方向、意义与价值。从佛教哲学的智慧出发，作品解读了“人生本是虚空”的命题，揭示无常与空性所构成的生死底层逻辑。一切物质与精神的存在均是暂时且变幻的，这种无常并不剥夺人生的意义，反而给艺术家提供了图像创造与精神追求的可能性。作品《虚无》试图在AI影像这种脆弱而流动的本质中发掘深刻的力量。它鼓励观众在面对虚空时不但不退缩，而且还以智慧赋予生命以意义。作品《虚无》是一场在虚无之中寻找永恒价值的探索，亦是一次关于存在与创造的深刻对话。

In Cheng Lin’s work “Nihility”, the artist captures the essence of life’s uncertainty through a profound philosophical lens. This uncertainty is interpreted as a broad concept of emptiness—encompassing the unknown future, inner fears, and the pressures of life. Through serene yet powerful AI-generated imagery, the work guides viewers to confront this existential void, seeking direction, meaning, and value hidden within.

Drawing from the wisdom of Buddhist philosophy, the piece interprets the notion that “life is inherently void,” revealing the underlying logic of impermanence and emptiness that shapes the cycle of life and death. All material and spiritual existence is transient and ever-changing, a concept that does not strip life of its meaning but instead provides the artist with opportunities for visual creation and spiritual pursuit.

“Nihility” explores the profound strength within the fragile and fluid nature of AI imagery. It encourages viewers not to retreat in the face of the void but to imbue life with meaning through wisdom. The work is both a journey to uncover eternal value within emptiness and a deep dialogue about existence and creation.

1839075943159828480.description:
《怨嗟的我》围绕一个出生于上世纪 90 年代的年轻人展开叙事。由于微薄的收入、买房贷款的负担，这位年轻人怀揣着的梦想终于破灭，最终决定离开曾经寄予希望的城市，回到农村老家。 田地在影片中大量探讨了幻灭和焦虑的主题，尝试引起了当今许多年轻人的共鸣，他们可能同样在社会的期望中，为成功而挣扎，并对勤奋的目的产生了怀疑。影片展示了在传统价值观和现代挑战之间徘徊的一代人的内心动荡。

Set in the milieu of contemporary China, The Sighing Me crafts a narrative centered around a young individual who was born in the 90s. Devastated by mediocre income, burden of a loan for a house left incomplete by the real estate developer, and the diminish of dreams, the protagonist finally decides to leave the city where his hope once lay and return to his hometown in the countryside.

Di heavily explores themes of disillusionment and anxiety that resonate with many young Chinese people today who also struggle for success amidst societal expectations and question the purpose of hardworking, showcasing the inner turmoil of a generation caught between traditional values and modern challenges.
1839075943159828480.tag: 数字动画,3D动画,动作捕捉

comments.name: 顾振清
comments.comment:
田地作品《怨嗟的我》探讨中国90后年轻人在现代性转型社会的生存夹缝中谋求物质与精神出路的内心焦虑与情绪波澜。这位年轻人背负着沉重的经济压力与社会期待，最终在梦想破灭的现实中离城返乡。影片通过对传统与现代之间富有张力的视觉表现，揭示了年轻一代在经济困境与文化冲突中的心灵挣扎。作品展现了年轻人对勤奋、成功、传统伦理和价值观的反思，尤其是在不断变化的社会结构中，许多人对追求物质成功的意义产生了质疑。通过细腻的叙事和丰富的情感层次，影片为当代年轻人群体的内心世界提供了一个真实的映射，呼唤着对个体生活选择与自我实现的关注。

Di Tian’s “The Sighing Me” delves into the inner anxieties and emotional turbulence of China’s post-90s generation as they navigate the pressures of material and spiritual survival in a rapidly transforming society. This young individual, burdened by immense economic pressure and societal expectations, ultimately retreats from the shattered dreams of urban life to return to their rural roots.

The film uses visually compelling depictions of the tension between tradition and modernity to reveal the spiritual struggles of a generation caught in economic hardship and cultural conflict. It reflects on the younger generation’s critical reassessment of diligence, success, traditional ethics, and values, particularly as the shifting social structures lead many to question the meaning of pursuing material success.

Through delicate storytelling and layered emotional depth, the film offers an authentic portrayal of the inner world of contemporary youth. It calls for greater attention to individual life choices and the pursuit of self-realization, serving as a poignant commentary on the challenges and aspirations of a generation at the crossroads of tradition and modernity.

1839075943159828480.artist_bio:
田地，来自中国重庆，现居美国纽约，新媒体艺术家。他在芝加哥艺术学院获得学士学位，并在宾夕法尼亚大学获得硕士学位。现为宾夕法尼亚州立大学数字艺术系教授。

Di Tian is a New York-based new-media artist from Chongqing, China. He received his B.F.A degree from School of the Art Institute of Chicago and M.F.A degree from University of Pennsylvania. He is now working as an Assistant Teaching Professor in Digital Arts at Penn State University.

1838967121921576960.description:
Binary Synergy Ballet is a dance animation generated by AI. AI learns and creates artistic concepts in the virtual identity of Erisen, generating four interpretation parts of "code awakening, digital pulsation, network expansion, and binary blooming". Whether it is theme construction, body movements, background music or picture presentation, they are all the results of AI generation.

Unlike the interpretation method of human beings based on skeleton-driven limbs, this body interpretation based on image generation logic gets rid of the constraints of bones on limbs and is the essential embodiment of generative AI. Erisen tries to redefine the body language of the AI era through dance, breaking through the traditional dance expression method and triggering deep thinking about the similarities and differences between AI and humans.

The design process of the work challenges the traditional human-led design method and uses a completely AIGC creation method. The performance plan constructed by the language model GPT is input into the image generation, audio generation, and language generation modules in the form of text prompts to generate all the audio-visual elements required for the performance, and organize all elements through the performance framework provided by AI. In this performance, in addition to providing the initial creative motivation, the human subject's job is to organize all the elements generated by AI according to the will generated by AI. This process reflects the different possibilities for art designers in their creation in the intelligent era.

comments.name: 顾振清
comments.comment:
在Metarter《二进制协同芭蕾舞》中，艺术家以生成式人工智能技术为创作媒介，构建了一场前所未有的舞蹈动画叙事。这部动画由 AI 以“艾里森”的虚拟身份生成，通过“代码觉醒、数字脉动、网络扩展、二进制绽放”四个篇章，探索了人工智能与艺术之间的深度协作。作品从主题构建到动作编排、从背景音乐到画面呈现的每个部分，均由生成式AI独立完成，打破了人类传统骨骼驱动肢体的舞蹈逻辑，呈现出独具未来感的身体语言。艾里森的表演重新定义了人工智能时代的艺术表达，挑战人类主导的创作模式。通过语言模型 GPT 构建的方案输入生成模块，作品实现了全流程的 AIGC 创作。在这一过程中，人类角色被简化为动机的提供者和生成元素的组织者，揭示了技术驱动下艺术创作的新可能性。《二进制协同芭蕾舞》不仅是一场视觉与听觉的盛宴，更是一场关于人工智能与人类关系的深刻思辨，昭示了智能时代艺术设计的未来图景。

In “Binary Synergy Ballet” by Metarter, the artist employs generative AI technology as the creative medium to craft an unprecedented animated dance narrative. This animation, generated by AI under the virtual persona “Erisen” unfolds across four chapters: “code awakening, digital pulsation, network expansion, and binary blooming” exploring the profound collaboration between artificial intelligence and art.

From thematic construction to choreography, background music to visual presentation, every aspect of the work is independently produced by generative AI. It breaks away from traditional human-driven skeletal motion in dance, presenting a futuristic body language. Erisen’s performance redefines artistic expression in the AI era, challenging the human-dominated creative paradigm. Utilizing input-output schemes constructed with language models like GPT, the project achieves a fully automated AIGC (AI-generated content) workflow. In this process, the human role is reduced to that of a motivator and organizer of generated elements, unveiling new possibilities for technology-driven art creation.

“Binary Synergy Ballet” is not only a feast for the senses but also a profound meditation on the relationship between AI and humanity. It heralds a future vision of artistic design in the intelligent age, offering both inspiration and a critical lens for rethinking the boundaries of creativity.

1838848888660955136.description:
Tao Yuanming, a famous poet in the Wei and Jin Dynasties, wrote in his book The Peach Blossom Source, an ideal society far from war and oppression, where people enjoyed a life of peace and freedom. Through the depiction of peace, happiness, freedom and equality in Taohuayuan, Tao Yuanming shows that people in Taohuayuan pursue a better life, pay attention to personal internal cultivation, and achieve inner peace and tranquility without external interference, and also expresses the author's escape and withdrawal from the world after disillusionment. Following the imagination of time and space along this path, I created this series of peach pink works about the entrance to the peach flower source. This series of works is dominated by strong peach pink color, based on the intention of traditional Chinese landscape painting, but it seems that this scene is not from the human world. This is my imagination of the entrance to the parallel universe of Peach Blossom Land, my Doraemon space-time gate, and also a utopian imagination. The mountains here may not be mountains, they are curves, they are fractal geometry, and the water here is not necessarily water, it is the space thought of the Russian mathematician Voronoi, it is a crystal, it is the substructure of water, it is oxygen and hydrogen, and it may be hidden in the mustard seeds. They seem to be layered water, like plants, like clouds, abstract and poetic, gentle, deeply attached, charming, psychedelic. But the same as the traditional "landscape" concept is the "Tao law" that I pursue, which includes heavenly way, humanity, world outlook, dream, faith, sense of belonging and so on.

魏晋著名的诗人陶渊明在他所写的《桃花源记》描述了一个远离战乱和压迫的理想社会，这里的人们享受着和平与自由的生活。陶渊明通过对桃花源安宁和乐、自由平等的描绘，展现桃花源内的人们对美好的生活的追求，注重个人内修，不被外界干扰得以实现内心的平静与安宁，同时也表达着作者在理想幻灭之后的逃避与遁世。沿着这条路径关于时间空间的想象，我创作了这一系列桃粉色的关于桃花源入口的作品。这系列作品以浓烈的桃花粉红为主色调，基于中国传统山水的意向而绘，而此景又并不来自人间。 这是一个我对桃花源平行宇宙空间入口的畅想，是我的多啦 a 梦时空门，也是一个乌托邦想象。这里的山或许不是山，是曲线，是分形几何，这里的水也不一定是水，是俄罗斯数学家沃罗诺伊的空间思想，是晶体，是水分子结构，是氧与氢，是芥子里或许藏着的须弥。它们似乎是层层叠叠的流水，似是植物，似是云烟，抽象且诗意，温柔，缱绻，旖旎，迷幻。但与传统“山水”概念相同的是我追寻的“道法”，天道、人道、世界观、梦想、信仰、归属感等诸多。
1838848888660955136.artist_bio:
艺术家林苒
Lin Ran, born in China, teaches at the Fine Arts College of Xiamen Jimei University, and is the deputy secretary general of the comprehensive Materials Painting Art Committee of Fujian Artists Association. After studying and working in France for 8 years, She successively graduated from the Contemporary Plastic Arts major of the Ecole Nationale Superieure des Beaux-arts in Paris and the New Media Art major of the Ecole Nationale Superieure des Beaux-Arts in Rouen, France. Ph.D., New Media Arts, School of Humanities, Xiamen University. She used to be Artron.net's art criticism column writer and published more than one million words of art criticism articles.
Lin Ran's works use narrative, narrative, sociological and textual methodologies to explore and discuss space and theater in modern society, feminist and transgender art, group psychology, and collective memory. His works are often based on sociological and cultural research and field investigation, and use multi-media Photography and video, animation, experimental painting, installation, performance and other artistic methods to integrate and learn from each other, to explore his own life experience and the current social reality. As an artist who received basic art education in China and received systematic European philosophical thinking and aesthetic training in France for many years, Lin Ran's own experience, regional identity and value identity determine the style and theme of her creation, but her complex and diverse experience and identity make her creation difficult to be summarized by simple symbols.
Lin Ran founded the virtual reality mixed reality art project Steal Touch Art Museum in September 2018, as the director, and created the virtual IP art docent Tuotuo Sister in the Art museum (China National Copyright registration). In 2017, the initial idea was formed, and in October 2019, the research project "SensLAB" was founded, which spanned the group psychology of art therapy with virtual reality art and mixed reality art. The installation "One cubic meter of Trust" created from the collection of public trust gifts (688 trust gifts have been collected), and the performance photography project "Body Theater" with more than 20,000 pieces of ordinary people are included in the institute as a case of group psychology art therapy. He has worked and lived in Xiamen and Europe for a long time.
In 2019, Lin Ran was invited to the Budanon Art Center in Sydney, Australia to hold a solo exhibition. She has held solo exhibitions in many places around the world, participated in the 9th Shanghai Biennale in 2012, the female art exhibition "Internal Combustion" in the Broad Art Museum in Michigan in 2016, the first in 2015 and the fifth in 2019. Arles International Photography Festival, Paris International Ultra Short Film Festival, Clermont-Ferrand International Short Film Festival, Independent Artist Invitational Exhibition, Mediterranean International Film Festival Short Film Section, Malaysia Art Fair, 40th Anniversary of the Establishment of Diplomatic Relations between China and Malaysia, Beijing Tree Art Museum, National Art Fund Global multi-city tour project, China's Fujian Provincial Art Museum "Absent Identity" National Nomination exhibition of Chinese Female artists and 2024 Fujian Provincial Art Museum "Nomadic Southeast" Female artist Case study exhibition and other large-scale Chinese and international exhibitions.
Lin Ran participated in a total of 129 exhibitions, 8 solo exhibitions. His works have been collected by many important domestic and foreign public art institutions, luxury brands and private collectors.
Lin Ran, a traveler constantly moving forward in art and philosophy, her stories and works are a profound insight into life, infinite love for art, and the pursuit and transmission of beauty.
